ideas.title: Product photo cleanup for small sellers
ideas.one_liner: Etsy and eBay sellers pay per batch to get phone photos cut out, lit and background-cleaned.
steps: Re-shoot 3 items from your own home
Edit them free for one Etsy seller
Offer $12 per product, 5 photos for the first batch
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Never claim studio quality from phone shots
Fix white balance before cutting out
Keep the seller's listing sizes exact
